summary: Hub Group filed an 8-K reporting a Third Amendment to its June 20, 2025 credit agreement, extending delivery of its FY2025 audited and Q1–Q3 2026 unaudited financial statements to November 30, 2026, and adding back restatement-related expenses to EBITDA. The same filing discloses preliminary Q1/Q2 2026 results via press release and an Item 5.02 appointment of a new Chief Executive Officer effective September 13, 2026. The CEO transition, layered atop an ongoing restatement and covenant relief, is the event; watch disclosure timing, restated financials, and any covenant or liquidity pressure.
